messages:
amelia: Quick follow-up from the Cobalt Health postmortem — sketching the immediate remediation plan for the VPC peering isolation we saw. Need owners + short timelines by EOD.

amelia: TL;DR of actions I think matter most:
1) Validate and repro MTU/fragmentation behavior on the peered path (affects on-prem appliance).
2) Add synthetic heartbeat + packet-loss alerting for peered links (so we detect flaps before customers do).
3) Harden the peering rollback/play for ignition/config drift on the customer's edge device.
4) Triage the isolation-bug trace to see if KV cache eviction amplified the outage.

amelia: Proposed owners/ETAs: 1) sanjay — 72h. 2) lucas + yara — 5 working days for probe + dashboard. 3) maria — 48h to draft rollback playbook. 4) ops triage — 24h experimental trace. Please confirm or reassign.

sanjay: @amelia I can take 1). I'll start with reproducer steps against their test appliance, then run `tcpdump -i eth0 -s0 -w mturepro.pcap` while varying mtu on the tunnel. ETA 48h to initial findings, 72h for full repro+root cause. :thumbsup:

sanjay: quick note — I need the customer staging config (the one with jumbo frames disabled). @maria can you drop the sanitized config into the ticket?

maria: uploaded sanitized config to IN-4321. Also added the original peering route table and the onprem appliance serial logs. Let me know if you need anything else. :white_check_mark:

lucas: I'll pair with yara for 2). Plan: small UDP/TCP synthetic probe from two regions -> compare latency/jitter + track packet reordering. Will add dashboard in Grafana and an alert rule in ops-alerts if loss > 1% for 2m.

yara: also add a circuit-breaker metric for sustained packet loss so we can auto-failover to dedicated routing if thresholds hit. I'll prototype the exporter in a day.

amelia: for 3) — Maria you draft rollback steps for both our control plane (route table revert) and a suggested onprem rollback (appliance reboot order + config apply). Keep playbook < 1 page. Put in IN-4321 under "runbook/rollback".

maria: will do. planning a short checklist + `aws` CLI commands and the onprem sequence. example snippet:```bash
# revert peering route to last-known-good
aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-0123abcd --destination-cidr-block 10.0.0.0/16 --gateway-id pcx-0abc1234
```

amelia: 4) KV cache eviction angle — lucas can you surface any correlation between cache evictions and increased latency? If not, label as low impact. If yes, we escalate to eng-runtime.

lucas: I'll grep the traces and correlate with our kv-evict metrics. Quick hypothesis: large multi-tenant requests caused cache churn during the incident window. Will confirm.

amelia: If any owner needs handoff, we should document now. I don't want tasks drifting into the general "remediation backlog". Let's also set a recurring 15m stand for next 3 days to clear blockers.

yara: I can host the 15m stand at 4pm PT today through Thursday. I'll create a calendar invite and add the incident channel.

sanjay: Confirmed — I might need a brief window on Mon to test with Cobalt staging. Flagging potential need for a spare liaison if the customer appliance requires onsite access.

maria: Added a note in IN-4321 about required customer approvals for remote tests. Customer ops contact: rachel@cobalt-health.com.

ops-bot: Incident IN-4321 status updated: "Follow-up actions assigned" — assignees: sanjay, lucas, yara, maria. SLA next checkpoint in 72h.

amelia: Great — last ask: owners, paste short progress updates in this thread only (one-line). We'll keep the ticket for artifacts and this thread for quick sync.

sanjay: 1713460500: sanjay — started MTU repro, captured first pcap, seeing reassembly errors when DF set. Will paste pcap link.

lucas: 1713460500: lucas — probe skeleton up, initial 1 min run shows 0.6% packet loss between eu-west-1 and us-west-2 on their peered path.

yara: 1713460500: yara — created alert rule draft in ops-alerts, linking to Grafana panel.

maria: 1713460500: maria — rollback draft uploaded to IN-4321/runbook, short checklist included.

amelia: Thanks all — we'll reconvene tomorrow at the 4pm PT stand. :handshake:
